free_tier.stated: The Free plan is USD 0 a month with no included credit, one concurrent sandbox, three snapshots per sandbox and 100 GiB of egress per account each month refused beyond the allowance and never charged; paid calls need prepaid credit on the owner's account. Usage is USD 0.010446 per vCPU-hour, USD 0.007051 per memory GB-hour and USD 0.000734 per disk GB-hour, billed per second with a USD 0.04 hourly minimum

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: The primary constraint is the virtual machine hardware specification.

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine or an account, not stored bytes
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process, not a stored object

egress.terms: outbound traffic is counted per UTC calendar month and inbound traffic is free; the Free plan allows 100 GiB per account each month and refuses beyond it without charge, Pro and Team allow 2 TB a month and then charge $0.05/GB and $0.04/GB respectively
egress.free_allowance: 100 GiB per account each month on Free, refused beyond it; 2 TB per account each month on Pro and Team

interface_detail: an SDK published as @tangle-network/sandbox, the tangle CLI, and plain HTTPS control-plane calls
tooling: an SDK published as @tangle-network/sandbox with a CLI, driving shells, ports, desktop and trace
chaining: a prepaid balance plus one concurrent sandbox makes this a single-job lane; parallelism needs a paid plan rather than more credit

limits.value: the entry plan refuses egress beyond 100 GiB a month and allows one concurrent sandbox, so a second parallel job waits rather than bills
